item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Nov 15 - 21, 2026)
item.description: Two unauthenticated remote code execution bugs in nginx lead the security reading this week, next to a KVM guest-to-host escape that sat in the kernel for four years and Jensen Huang leaving Nvidia after 33 years. Around them, Gemini 4 Neon and Qwen4-Max landing two days apart, GTA 6 reviews after a hundred hours in Vice City, and a strong week for property-based testing. Security Unauthenticated remote code execution in NGINX / NGINX2Root - CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, found independently by Wiz Research, Ikotas Labs, Metnir, Rapid7 and Xint, are critical pre-authentication RCEs in nginx that need HTTP/2 enabled.
